_what: Every column in the identity store (self-hosted GoTrue on Box C) that can hold a network address, and the value a write leaves in it. SYN-P2: every app notice says no network address is stored, and the identity store is inside that promise. tooling/ci/assert-app-yaml.mjs limb 10 refuses any column here that the trigger file does not empty on write, and an empty list (COVERAGE LOST).
_measuredBy: A catalog read on Box C, counts and names only: every inet or cidr column and every column named ip, *_ip, ip_address, remote_addr or client_ip, in both databases of the stack (postgres and _supabase). The query is the first block of the trigger file's header. Re-run it after every GoTrue image upgrade: a new column is an address the notice would then wrongly deny.
